chunks.translation: Om, invoke for me the golden-hued, radiant Goddess Lakshmi, adorned with gold and silver garlands.

chunks.sanskrit: च॒न्द्रां हि॒रण्म॑यीं ल॒क्ष्मीं जात॑वेदो म॒ आव॑ह ॥ १ ॥
chunks.translation: Resplendent like the cool moon, made of pure gold — O Agni Jatavedas, bring Her to me!
O Jatavedas, bring to me that Lakshmi who never departs from me.
Through whom I shall attain lasting wealth in gold, cattle, horses, and noble kin.
Preceded by horses, riding in the midst of golden chariots, awakened by the joyous trumpeting of elephants.
I invoke the radiant Goddess Sri; may the glorious Mother be gracious unto me.

chunks.sanskrit: कां सो᳚स्मि॒तां हिर॑ण्यप्रा॒कारा॑मा॒र्द्रां ज्वल॑न्तीं तृ॒प्तां त॒र्पय॑न्तीम् ।
chunks.translation: She who is smiled upon, surrounded by golden ramparts, ever-compassionate, shining, supremely contented and fulfilling all desires.
Enthroned upon a lotus and lotus-complexioned — Her, the Goddess Sri, I invoke here.

chunks.sanskrit: च॒न्द्रां प्र॑भा॒सां य॒शसा॒ ज्वल॑न्तीं॒ श्रियं॑ लो॒के दे॒वजु॑ष्टामुदा॒राम् ।
chunks.translation: Delightful as the moon, dazzling with lustre, shining with boundless renown, adored by the celestials and supremely bountiful.

chunks.sanskrit: तां प॒द्मिनी॑मीं॒ शर॑णम॒हं प्रप॑द्येऽल॒क्ष्मीर्मे॑ नश्यतां॒ त्वां वृ॑णे ॥ ५ ॥
chunks.translation: In Her, the lotus-dwelling Mother, I take refuge. May my poverty and misery be destroyed forever; I seek Thee alone.
O Mother radiant as the rising sun! By Thy intense spiritual tapasyā was born the holy Bilva tree.

chunks.sanskrit: तस्य॒ फला॑नि॒ तप॒सा नु॑दन्तु मा॒यान्त॑रा॒याश्च॑ बा॒ह्या अ॑ल॒क्ष्मीः ॥ ६ ॥
chunks.translation: May its auspicious fruits, through spiritual merit, remove all my internal illusions and external misfortunes.

chunks.sanskrit: उपै॑तु॒ मां दे॑वस॒खः की॒र्तिश्च॒ मनि॑ना स॒ह ।
chunks.translation: May Kubera, the companion of the gods, along with Fame and the wish-yielding jewel, approach me.
Born in this noble realm, may She bestow upon me enduring honor, prosperity, and spiritual fulfillment.
I banish the elder sister Alakshmi (misfortune), tormented by hunger and thirst, impure and decaying.

chunks.sanskrit: अभू॑ति॒मसमृ॑द्धिं॒ च सर्वां॒ निर्णु॑द मे॒ गृहा᳚त् ॥ ८ ॥
chunks.translation: Dispel from my dwelling all failure, penury, and lack of abundance!
Approachable through divine fragrance, invincible, ever-nourished, sustaining all agricultural abundance.
The Supreme Sovereign of all living beings — Her, Sri Mahalakshmi, I invoke here.
May I realize the purest intentions of the mind, the noble resolve of the heart, and truthful speech.

chunks.sanskrit: प॒शू॒नां रू॒पमन्न॑स्य॒ मयि॒ श्रीः श्र॑यतां॒ यशः॑ ॥ १० ॥
chunks.translation: In cattle, nourishment, beauty, and honor, may the divine grace of Sri permanently abide within me.
Through sage Kardama, Goddess Sri took birth as offspring. O Kardama, abide auspiciously in my abode!

chunks.sanskrit: श्रियं॑ वा॒सय॑ मे कु॒ले मा॒तरं॑ पद्म॒मालि॑नीम् ॥ ११ ॥
chunks.translation: Cause the divine Mother Sri, crowned with fragrant lotus garlands, to dwell forever in my lineage.

chunks.sanskrit: आपः॑ सृ॒जन्तु॑ स्नि॒ग्धानि॒ चिक्ली॒त व॑स मे॒ गृहे ।
chunks.translation: May the sacred Waters pour forth sweet and nourishing blessings. O sage Chiklita, dwell in my home!
And establish the divine Mother, Goddess Lakshmi, permanently within my family.
O Agni, invoke Her who is tender, blooming like a pond of lotuses, the embodiment of vitality, golden-hued, garlanded with blossoms.

chunks.sanskrit: च॒न्द्रां हि॒रण्म॑यीं ल॒क्ष्मीं जात॑वेदो म॒ आव॑ह ॥ १३ ॥
chunks.translation: Shining as the moon, of pure gold — bring that Lakshmi to me, O Jatavedas!

chunks.sanskrit: आ॒र्द्रां यः॒ करि॑णीं य॒ष्टिं सु॒व॒र्णां हे॑ममा॒लिनीम् ।
chunks.translation: Invoke Her who holds the royal sceptre of universal dominion, radiant with golden ornaments.

chunks.sanskrit: सूर्यां॑ हि॒रण्म॑यीं ल॒क्ष्मीं जात॑वेदो म॒ आव॑ह ॥ १४ ॥
chunks.translation: Radiant as the spiritual sun, made of imperishable gold — bring Her to me, O Jatavedas!
O Agni, bring to me that ever-faithful Lakshmi who shall never abandon me.

chunks.sanskrit: यस्यां॒ हिर॑ण्यं॒ प्रभू॑तं॒ गावो॑ दा॒स्योऽश्वा᳚न्वि॒न्देयं॒ पुरु॑षान॒हम् ॥ १५ ॥
chunks.translation: In whom I shall find boundless gold, abundant cattle, devoted helpers, swift horses, and noble descendants.
Whoever, becoming pure and devoted, offers daily oblations of clarified butter into the sacred fire,

chunks.sanskrit: सूक्तं॑ पञ्चद॒शर्चं॑ च श्री॒कामः॑ सत॒तं ज॑पेत् ॥ १६ ॥
chunks.translation: And continuously recites this fifteen-verse hymn of Sri, will attain supreme spiritual and material grace.
